cases.question: Какой район лидирует по числу выездов в каждом квартале?
cases.gold_sql:
SELECT quarter, district, departures
FROM (
    SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date) AS quarter,
           district,
           COUNT(*) AS departures,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date)
               ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM pss_departures
    GROUP BY quarter, district
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY quarter;
cases.predicted_sql:
WITH quarterly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        district,
        EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date) AS quarter,
        COUNT(*) AS departures
    FROM pss_departures
    GROUP BY district, quarter
)
SELECT 
    district, 
    quarter, 
    MAX(departures) AS max_departures
FROM quarterly_counts
GROUP BY district, quarter
ORDER BY district, quarter;
